notes: Downstage 1.2: elastic audio (stretch a clip to a new length at the same pitch, without touching the file); a pitch editor on every clip (detect the notes, drag them, snap to a key and scale, or draw the pitch with a pencil on the waveform) and a Pitch Corrector unit for live voices; a notes post-it on every channel; the master and every aux patched to any output pair, or to No out; audio streamed from a disk cache instead of filling the memory; exports that stream to disk; an engine that follows device and sample-rate changes and restarts itself; the waveform of every clip drawn right.
